nodes.name: Receive ReportContentPackage
nodes.notes: SSRF defense: authentication required. Only the Prysm worker may invoke this webhook. The worker injects modelEndpoint from server-side config, NOT from the webhook body.

parameters.jsCode:
// Deterministic mock — worker provides pre-built response
return [{ json: { narrative: $input.first().json.narrative, mode: 'mock' } }];

// Validated cached response from worker
return [{ json: { narrative: $input.first().json.narrative, mode: 'replay' } }];

// Worker persists narrative.json + usage ledger
return [{ json: { persisted: true, narrative: $input.first().json.narrative } }];
